q: Which Indian foundry clusters did the national energy study cover, and where does my foundry fit?
title: India's foundry clusters: energy use
short: India has about 5,000 foundries, around 3,680 operating, using 0.9 Mtoe a year. A national study of 14 clusters, from Agra to Shivamogga, found they use about 0.4 Mtoe, roughly 45% of it, at 3.2 to 5.0 GJ per tonne. Work out your own GJ per tonne to see where you sit.
audience: Foundry owners and associations comparing their energy use with other clusters

p: Agra, Ahmedabad, Batala-Jalandhar-Ludhiana, Belagavi, Coimbatore, Faridabad, Indore, Kolhapur, Howrah, Jaipur, Rajkot, Samalkha, Shivamogga and Saharanpur. Ahmedabad and Rajkot were picked for detailed energy audits.

ul: Foundries: about 0.9 Mtoe and 6.6 million t CO2 a year.
Cupolas on coke melt about 69% of liquid metal, induction furnaces about 31%.
The 14 clusters average about 28,600 toe each, so clusters differ widely. Indore used 5,516 toe in 2007-08 and Samalkha 3,300 toe in 2015.

ol: Add a year's electricity: kWh x 0.0036 gives GJ.
Add coke: tonnes x 28.2 GJ (IPCC default), plus any oil or gas from its invoices.
Divide by tonnes of saleable castings.
Compare with 3.2 to 5.0 GJ per tonne. Above 5, look first at yield, rejections and melting.

p: Two foundries at the same GJ per tonne can emit very different CO2. A GJ of grid electricity carries about 0.19 t CO2 at 0.675 kg per kWh; a GJ of coke about 0.11 t. Report both figures.

example.title: A 600 t a year cupola foundry (estimate)
lines: Total 2,331 GJ / 600 t = about 3.9 GJ per tonne, inside the study's range
example.note: Inputs are the Samalkha profile's typical unit. Studies may convert fuels differently, so compare ranges, not decimals.

senseible: Senseible turns your bills and fuel invoices into a carbon number per tonne, labelled with the factors used, so the comparison with your cluster rests on your own records.
